analysis.one_line_summary: A Lebanese creator demonstrates a step-by-step bouncy blowout routine at home using the Wavytalk Blowout Boost thermal brush.
analysis.full_description: A woman speaks to the camera and through voiceover, demonstrating how to achieve a bouncy, high-volume salon-style blowout at home. She styles a front section first to show the lifting and gliding technique with the Wavytalk Blowout Boost thermal brush, reveals the dramatic bouncy curl result, repeats the technique across her hair, showcases the full bouncy blowout finish, details the product features (heats up in 30 seconds, styles whole hair easily), and ends with a 20% off call to action.

transcript.speaker: creator
transcript.text_original: بدك blowout فيه volume و bounce بالبيت بلا ما ياخد وقت طويل؟ شوفي قديه أخد معي.
transcript.text_english: Do you want a blowout with volume and bounce at home without taking a long time? Look how long it took me.

transcript.speaker: creator
transcript.text_english: First thing, we set the timer.

transcript.speaker: creator
transcript.text_original: رح بلش بالـ section اللي فوق لأعمل أكتر volume. باخد خصلة صغيرة برفعها لفوق وبحط الـ brush تحت الـ roots.
transcript.text_english: I'll start with the top section to create the most volume. I take a small section, lift it up, and place the brush under the roots.

transcript.speaker: creator
transcript.text_original: لأعمل maximum volume بضل مرق الـ brush directly لتحت بلفها لورا ت تلف الخصلة حولها وبخليها كم ثانية عند الـ roots.
transcript.text_english: To create maximum volume, I keep passing the brush directly down, rolling it back so the hair wraps around it, and I leave it for a few seconds at the roots.

transcript.speaker: creator
transcript.text_original: وأنا وعم مرق الـ brush بحافظ على tension خفيفة. بمرقها شوي شوي ع طول الخصلة وبلف، وآخر شي لبرا قبل ما شيل عن الخصلة.
transcript.text_english: And while running the brush through, I maintain gentle tension. I glide it slowly down the strand and twist outward at the very end before releasing.

transcript.speaker: creator
transcript.text_original: شوفوا الفرق قديه طلع حلو. الـ roots أخدوا lift والخصلة صار فيها shape و bounce.
transcript.text_english: Look at the difference, how nice it turned out! The roots got a lift and the strand got shape and bounce.

transcript.speaker: creator
transcript.text_original: وهلأ رح استعمل نفس الـ technique على باقي شعري. بلف الـ brush ع الخصلة مع tension خفيفة وباخد خصل صغيرة كرمال يبين شعري open و bouncy وفيه volume.
transcript.text_english: Now I will use the same technique on the rest of my hair. I roll the brush on the section with gentle tension and take small sections so my hair looks open, bouncy, and voluminous.

transcript.speaker: creator
transcript.text_original: وهلأ خلونا نوقف الـ timer. انتو بس شوفولي قديه طلع result حلو.
transcript.text_english: And now let's stop the timer. Just look at how gorgeous the result turned out!

transcript.speaker: creator
transcript.text_original: الـ tool اللي عم بستعملها هي Wavytalk Blowout Boost. نقيتها لأنها بتحمى بس بـ 30 ثانية، بقدر زبط شعري كله بنفس الـ brush، وهيدا اللي بخليني خلص أسرع وبطريقة أسهل.
transcript.text_english: The tool I'm using is the Wavytalk Blowout Boost. I chose it because it heats up in just 30 seconds, I can style all my hair with the same brush, and that lets me finish faster and more easily.

transcript.speaker: creator
transcript.text_original: وإذا إنتي كمان بدك هيدا الـ volume بشعرك، اطلبي the Wavytalk Blowout Boost بـ 20% off.
transcript.text_english: And if you also want this volume in your hair, order the Wavytalk Blowout Boost at 20% off.

analysis.transcript_full_original: بدك blowout فيه volume و bounce بالبيت بلا ما ياخد وقت طويل؟ شوفي قديه أخد معي. أول شي حطينا الـ timer. رح بلش بالـ section اللي فوق لأعمل أكتر volume. باخد خصلة صغيرة برفعها لفوق وبحط الـ brush تحت الـ roots. لأعمل maximum volume بضل مرق الـ brush directly لتحت بلفها لورا ت تلف الخصلة حولها وبخليها كم ثانية عند الـ roots. وأنا وعم مرق الـ brush بحافظ على tension خفيفة. بمرقها شوي شوي ع طول الخصلة وبلف، وآخر شي لبرا قبل ما شيل عن الخصلة. شوفوا الفرق قديه طلع حلو. الـ roots أخدوا lift والخصلة صار فيها shape و bounce. وهلأ رح استعمل نفس الـ technique على باقي شعري. بلف الـ brush ع الخصلة مع tension خفيفة وباخد خصل صغيرة كرمال يبين شعري open و bouncy وفيه volume. وهلأ خلونا نوقف الـ timer. انتو بس شوفولي قديه طلع result حلو. الـ tool اللي عم بستعملها هي Wavytalk Blowout Boost. نقيتها لأنها بتحمى بس بـ 30 ثانية، بقدر زبط شعري كله بنفس الـ brush، وهيدا اللي بخليني خلص أسرع وبطريقة أسهل. وإذا إنتي كمان بدك هيدا الـ volume بشعرك، اطلبي the Wavytalk Blowout Boost بـ 20% off.
analysis.transcript_full_english: Do you want a blowout with volume and bounce at home without taking a long time? Look how long it took me. First thing, we set the timer. I'll start with the top section to create the most volume. I take a small section, lift it up, and place the brush under the roots. To create maximum volume, I keep passing the brush directly down, rolling it back so the hair wraps around it, and I leave it for a few seconds at the roots. And while running the brush through, I maintain gentle tension. I glide it slowly down the strand and twist outward at the very end before releasing. Look at the difference, how nice it turned out! The roots got a lift and the strand got shape and bounce. Now I will use the same technique on the rest of my hair. I roll the brush on the section with gentle tension and take small sections so my hair looks open, bouncy, and voluminous. And now let's stop the timer. Just look at how gorgeous the result turned out! The tool I'm using is the Wavytalk Blowout Boost. I chose it because it heats up in just 30 seconds, I can style all my hair with the same brush, and that lets me finish faster and more easily. And if you also want this volume in your hair, order the Wavytalk Blowout Boost at 20% off.
